ai_language_tip: 模里西斯、塞席爾可作法語或英語，用 vous／Sir-Madam，不要用克里奧爾語（不在支援清單）。葛摩場合可改用阿拉伯語或法語。模里西斯法語帶島國詞，不要整段套用巴黎口語。
english_ok: often — 模里西斯與塞席爾旅館、餐廳與診所英語普遍；葛摩行政場合法語與阿拉伯語較強，英語較不穩定。
politeness: 法語開場 Bonjour 加 vous；英語 Good morning 加 a short greeting before the request。葛摩對陌生人也保持正式。結尾 merci / thank you。
name_tip: 報名加姓（如 Aisha Ramkissoon、Jean-Luc Morel）；印裔、克里奧爾與穆斯林姓名都常見，先用訂位已寫的拼法再逐字拼。
phone_tip: 模里西斯 8 位，手機多以 5 開頭（5 123 4567），市話常見 2 開頭；塞席爾與葛摩多為 7 位。國際冠碼 +230 / +248 / +269。朗讀分組。
time_tip: 書面 24 小時與 12 小時並用；模里西斯、塞席爾晚餐多在 19:00–20:30。口語英語用 am/pm，法語用 19h30。
number_tip: 模里西斯盧比、塞席爾盧比、葛摩法郎不要混用。模里西斯商店常掃 MCB Juice 或 my.t money 的 QR，不要把它們說成三國通用。
avoid_calling: 避開 12:00–13:30 午餐與 19:00–21:00 晚餐高峰；週日上午許多市區店較晚開。葛摩避開週五中午禮拜時段。
closed_days: 模里西斯公共假期多（獨立／共和紀念日、勞動節、耶誕，以及印裔與穆斯林節日，以總理府公告為準）；塞席爾與葛摩假期不完全相同，葛摩在開齋節、古爾邦節更常全休。
booking_channels: 模里西斯餐廳可用 Bookatable 或 Eat App 留桌，也可打電話；外送有 Ordermanzer、Hungry Dodo 等本地 App，沒有 Uber Eats。診所、水電與多數小店靠 WhatsApp。塞席爾渡假村常用旅館 App 或櫃檯訂餐。葛摩多為電話與 WhatsApp。支付在模里西斯常見 Juice。
voice_menu: 模里西斯銀行（含 MCB）、電信 my.t／Emtel 與部分公營事業有語音選單；塞席爾與葛摩多數小店仍人工接聽。
callback_habits: Bookatable／Eat App 會即時確認；小店與診所多用 WhatsApp。渡假村訂餐常在入住 App 或櫃檯回覆，不一定另打電話。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯可用 Bookatable 或 Eat App 留桌，熱門海灘餐廳週末常要先訂；塞席爾渡假村多經櫃檯或旅館 App，葛摩則以電話、WhatsApp 為主。
usually_asked: Date and sitting (lunch around 12:30 vs dinner around 19:30–20:30)
Party size and a high chair if needed
Indoor, veranda or seaside table
Name and an 8-digit Mauritius mobile, or the local format in Seychelles or Comoros
Whether a deposit or pre-order is required on Bookatable

may_come_up.what: A Bookatable or Eat App reference already exists and should be used
The table is in a resort restaurant and non-residents must be announced
Juice or a card guarantee is requested for a Saturday evening table in Grand Baie

sensitive_asked.what: A transfer to a personal Juice or mobile number is demanded before any written confirmation

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯私立診所常用電話或 WhatsApp 掛號，有時有診所網頁；塞席爾、葛摩多半直接打電話。要帶保險卡或現金。
usually_asked: First visit or follow-up and the specialty
Patient name and a local callback number
Cash, private insurance or a company account

may_come_up.what: Some surgeries only book mornings and close early on Saturday

sensitive_asked.what: A third party is asked to recite a full medical history on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 沙龍多用 WhatsApp 或電話預約，渡假村水療則走旅館櫃檯或專屬 App。
usually_asked: Hair, nails or spa treatment and the duration
Day and hour, plus a second choice
Whether the guest is staying in a named resort

may_come_up.what: A resort spa slot may be reserved only for in-house guests at peak hours

sensitive_asked.what: A personal-wallet deposit is demanded with no salon name on the transfer

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與家電多打電話或 WhatsApp 約，模里西斯市區較容易約到；外島零件常要等船期。
usually_asked: What failed and the make
Drop-off versus a visit at the residence
A window that works, including ferry timing if it is another island

may_come_up.what: A part must wait for the next freight from the main island

sensitive_asked.what: A remote fee to a personal account is demanded before the item is inspected

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯可用 Hungry Dodo、Ordermanzer 等本地外送，或直接 WhatsApp 給餐廳；塞席爾、葛摩多半自己取餐或請旅館代叫。
usually_asked: Dishes and portions, including a local plate if named (dholl puri, grilled fish, langouste)
Collection versus delivery in a named town (Port Louis, Grand Baie, Victoria)
A number the rider can call at the gate

may_come_up.what: International apps such as Uber Eats are not present; use a local service or the restaurant itself
Delivery may stop early outside the main towns

sensitive_asked.what: The rider asks to be paid into a personal Juice account that is not the restaurant's

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨用 WhatsApp 最常見；模里西斯較大連鎖才有網站庫存，電話只確認取貨日。
usually_asked: Item, size and quantity
Collect in store versus a courier between towns
Name for the set-aside goods

may_come_up.what: Stock is in Port Louis and would be sent to another town the next day

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private number is required before they confirm stock

change.before_dialing_zh: Bookatable 或 Eat App 的訂位在同一平台改；WhatsApp 訂的就回原對話。渡假村訂餐改期要經櫃檯。
usually_asked: Original date, hour and the name or booking reference
The new slot or a cancellation
New headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A deposit or pre-order already paid on Bookatable may have its own cancellation rule

sensitive_asked.what: An extra transfer is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問是否營業、收不收 Juice 或能不能帶小孩，直接打或傳 WhatsApp；渡假村餐廳先問櫃檯較準。
usually_asked: The exact question (hours, Juice or card, a dish, a ferry-day closure)
The day they plan to come
A number for a later reply

may_come_up.what: A beach restaurant may close on a public holiday even if a hotel nearby stays open

sensitive_asked.what: Someone asks the owner to read a Juice PIN or card code aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯與塞席爾渡假村多用官網、Booking.com 或集團 App；小賓館 WhatsApp 問空房。葛摩也是電話與訊息為主。
usually_asked: Arrival and departure dates and the number of guests
Room or villa type and meal plan
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A resort may already have the booking in its guest app and only needs a dinner seating

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan plus a transfer to a personal account is demanded before confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 跳島、潛水與山路行程多經旅遊社或旅館櫃檯預訂，天氣不佳會改期；不要只在社群留言就當成已確認。
usually_asked: Which excursion and the date, with a weather backup
Adults and children and the pickup (hotel or jetty)
A mobile that works on the island

may_come_up.what: The boat leaves only with a minimum number of guests
A marine-park fee may be cash-only

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯水電與清潔幾乎都用 WhatsApp 約，地址要寫鎮名與門牌；外島要把船班時間算進去。
usually_asked: The job and a visit window
Town, residence and how to enter the gate
A number that will answer on the day

may_come_up.what: A technician on Rodrigues or a Seychelles island may only travel on certain ferry days

sensitive_asked.what: A door code and a remote prepayment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯獸醫可電話或 WhatsApp 預約；塞席爾、葛摩選擇較少，通常先打電話問當天門診。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
First visit or vaccination
Owner name and a local number

may_come_up.what: Import or boarding may need a veterinary certificate

sensitive_asked.what: A personal transfer is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 海運與空運到島後常要打電話給代理行或郵局，單號加上航班或船舶名稱較有用。
usually_asked: Waybill or tracking number and the arrival island
Name on the consignment and a local contact
Collection depot versus a home delivery in a named town

may_come_up.what: A customs or freight balance may be due in local rupees before release

sensitive_asked.what: A wallet top-up is requested to 'release' an unidentified parcel

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯銀行與 my.t／Emtel 有語音選單與 App；不要在電話裡報 Juice 密碼。塞席爾、葛摩多半人工接聽。
usually_asked: Which bank or operator and the account or SIM
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: They may ask the customer to visit a branch with an ID card

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for a Juice PIN, card code or one-time SMS on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 模里西斯叫車有本地 App 與旅館計程車，很多行程仍用電話約司機；塞席爾、葛摩更常由旅館代叫，不要假設有 Uber。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (hotel, airport, town) and the time
Passengers and luggage, including ferry connections
A number the driver can call

may_come_up.what: A hotel car may be priced per trip rather than by an app meter

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal Juice account before sharing a plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介 WhatsApp 或電話約，模里西斯常見；要帶身份證明，地址用鎮名與 residence 名稱。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent or sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget in the local rupee or Comorian franc if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent may want to see an ID before entering a gated residence

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal account is demanded before any visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公家窗口與學校多用電話問文件，正式手續仍要本人到場；模里西斯假期多，先問當天是否辦公。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose
The person's name as on the ID or passport
Whether attendance in person is required and from which hour

may_come_up.what: A public holiday unique to Mauritius may close a counter that is open in Seychelles the same day

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from an office asks for a personal transfer to speed up a file
